race.comment: VIVIKA (14) is a promising mare set to return for the red-hot Matty Dunn camp. Has shown plenty of positive signs to date and looks to have come back in good order, stripping fitter for two trials. Gets the key booking of Thompson, who has already saluted aboard. Bold showing anticipated. BOSS MODE (11) is one of the immediate dangers after a strong win at Eagle Farm last time. The form around him is terrific with a stack of subsequent winners. The wide alley is the only concern. DISCREET POINT (19) is progressing nicely and should be at his top now after a dominant Ballina win. Gets in light and could prove tricky to run down if sent forward again. MISS MCLAREN (17) is another lightweight flyer. Draws to get the suck run and can give backers a good look. THUNDERING SOUL (1) is a s consistent as they come and keeps an important 3kg claim.
